nusmp.skill.book_mud.description: A grimoire of mud. Its pages throw heavy globs, send a wave of mud, turn the ground to a pit, burst a bog open, wrap you in a mud armour, and call a golem, spouts and walls. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_bolt: Mud Magic: Mud Ball - a heavy glob of mud that bursts on the first foe and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_cut: Mud Magic: Mud Wave - a wave of mud along a line: it cuts everything on it, throws it back and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_field: Mud Magic: Mud Pit - the ground at the aimed point turns to a pit for 8 seconds: foes sink in it, are slowed hard and weakened. Size scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_domain: Mud Magic: Bog Domain - the ground round the aimed point erupts: heavy damage, thrown back, then mired for a long time.
nusmp.page.book_mud.attribute_guard: Mud Magic: Mud Armor - the Bogplate armour drops onto you for 10 seconds, clod by clod: blows are softened by a third and whoever strikes you is slowed.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_golem: Mud Magic: Mud Golem - a golem of mud rises beside you for 20 seconds, follows you and pounds the nearest foe. It can be hit.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_spout: Mud Magic: Mud Spout - spouts of mud burst under up to four foes near the aimed point: damage and thrown up.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_wall: Mud Magic: Mud Wall - a wall of packed mud rises in front of you; foes in front of it are thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_shackle: Mud Magic: Mud Shackle - mud closes round one foe's legs (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock).
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_barrage: Mud Magic: Mud Barrage - for 3 seconds globs of mud rain on the aimed point.
